preset.appliesTo: All Berceuse pieces when preparing MIDI-based replacement recordings
preset.feedback: The maintainer likes the new YDP variant B very much and selects it as the preferred piano voice for future Berceuse conversions.
preset.soundbank: YDP Grand Piano, FreePats SF2 version 2016-08-04, Yamaha Disklavier Pro
preset.soundbankCredits: Zenph Studios, Dr. Mikhail Krishtal and team; OLPC sound sample library / Dr. Richard Boulanger; SF2 and sample modifications by Roberto (roberto@zenvoid.org), FreePats

renderSettings.tempo: Retain each recording's chosen audition tempo through MIDI-event timing; do not impose the Burgmuller tempo on other pieces or stretch rendered audio
renderSettings.loudnessStrategy: Constant gain only; retain safe peak headroom and note dynamics; no compressor or limiter

preset.verification: Confirm actual reverb in the output using a wet/dry comparison. Earlier Salamander A/B renders were effectively identical because no MIDI reverb send reached the effect. Check loudness matching, full decoding, headroom, quiet ending and retained credits before delivering an audition.
